<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def snap(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out={}
    for nd in seg['nodes']:
        if nd['color'] in ('N','O','G','c') and nd['pixels']>=4:
            out.setdefault(nd['color'],[]).append((nd['boundary'][0], nd['pixels']))
    return out
print("before:", snap(current_frame))
# click green peg (0,1)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':14}])
print("after click green(0,1):", snap(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done']})
# look for gray diamond target (w small) or ring
seg=current_frame.segmentation
for nd in seg['nodes']:
    if nd['color'] in ('G','c'):
        print("ring/target?", nd['color'], nd['pixels'], nd['boundary'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
